model.name: Qwen3.8-27B
model.note: Hybrid: 48 of 64 decode layers are linear attention (ssm_* state, no growing KV); only every 4th layer (3,7,..,63) is full attention. Fragility is still depth-localized, not attention-type-localized (prereg #101 P-1). n_layer is 65 because the GGUF block_count includes the MTP block (blk.64, carries attn_k + FFN) - this is the number autospec and the probe both read, so the recipe matches the real file.

provenance.method: band probe: one band's FFNs -> q2_k at a time, rest at base; delta vs reference
provenance.note: Probed launch-day+1 (weights landed 2026-08-14; prereg #101). Source was Q4_K_M, not BF16: a BF16 probe is infeasible on this box (prereg #101 amendment 2026-08-15), so band deltas are relative to a Q6_K reference requantized from Q4_K_M. The source's own quantization is common-mode and cancels in the deltas; band LOCATION is trustworthy, absolute BF16 loss is not measured here. fragility_ratio follows the atlas convention (max delta / statistics.median of the 4 deltas = 0.5926/0.25235 = 2.35), matching every sibling recipe; the probe binary's own banner printed 2.04 because it divides by its upper-median (0.29) - same data, different median convention, disclosed so the two published numbers do not read as a discrepancy.
